own.notes: Amounts are GBP pence. For integer quantity q in 1..1000, select the last segment with from <= q and predict max(0, round(constant + linear*q + quadratic*q*q)). The ranges are 1..293, 294..750 and 751..1000. Independently reconstructed from exact REA observations: all 95 distinct sampled quantities matched exactly, with maximum absolute error 0 pence. The model was fixed after 15 exploratory observations; all 80 subsequently queried quantities matched exactly, giving observed exact-match, within-1% and within-5% validation rates of 100%. Direct probes at 292, 293, 294, 295 and 749, 750, 751, 752 confirmed both rate changes. Samples include both domain endpoints, and the largest spacing between sampled quantities is 17. Confidence is high under the supported three-segment affine model, but only 95 of 1000 quantities were observed; narrow exceptions at unqueried quantities cannot be ruled out, and unseen accuracy is not proven.
